title: GeoFusion: An Uncertain Machine Learning Framework for Sensor Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.29510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High positioning precision is a critical requirement in many Global Positioning System (GPS) applications, yet achieving it with affordable smartphone sensors remains an open challenge. Existing approaches treat each GPS observation as an absolute point, discarding the uncertainty inherent in the measurement conditions and leaving the cooperative potential of multiple phones observing the same location untapped. In this work, we propose GeoFusion, a three-stage uncertain machine learning framework for cooperative sensor fusion. In the first stage, each GPS observation is modeled as an uncertain object using one of two proposed models: the volcano function, grounded in satellite geometry, and the empirically derived mountain function, built from the statistical structure of real smartphone data. tldr: GeoFusion提出一个三阶段不确定性机器学习框架，将GPS观测建模为不确定性对象（火山函数与山峰函数）并按位置事件聚类，从而利用多部智能手机的协作传感器融合提升定位精度。
